user.title: Connect to SnapDog
user.description: Enter the address of your SnapDog server. The API key is only needed if you enabled authentication in snapdog.toml.

reauth_confirm.title: Enter a new API key
reauth_confirm.description: The server rejected the API key.

error.invalid_auth: The server rejected the API key.
error.unsupported_version: This SnapDog version is too old. Update the server to 0.31.0 or newer.

abort.already_configured: This server is already set up.
abort.no_server_id: The announcement carries no server id. Add the server by hand.

request_failed.message: The SnapDog server refused the request: {error}

invalid_media_id.message: "{media_id}" is not a playlist, album or track of SnapDog.

unknown_playlist.message: The SnapDog server has no playlist "{playlist_id}".

unknown_source.message: The SnapDog server has no playlist called "{source}".

read_only.message: The SnapDog server refused the change ({error}). Playlists can only be changed when playlist_write is true in the [subsonic] section of the server configuration, and the radio list never.

unknown_server.message: "{entry}" is not a SnapDog server of this Home Assistant.

server_required.message: Name the SnapDog server with config_entry_id: this Home Assistant has {count} loaded.

server_not_loaded.message: The SnapDog server "{title}" is not set up.

zone_order_changed.title: SnapDog zones changed position
zone_order_changed.description: The zones of {server} are no longer at the same position in the server configuration: {zones}. Home Assistant identifies a zone by its position, so the history, areas and automations of these entities now belong to another zone. Restore the old order of the `[[zone]]` blocks in `snapdog.toml` and restart the server, or check the areas and automations of the zones listed. Dismiss this issue once that is done.
